title: MCP/A2A boundary envelope
description: The only shape that may cross the institution's outer boundary. Acceptance proves authenticity and well-formedness. It proves nothing about authority: a perfectly valid envelope becomes a PROPOSAL and nothing else.

protocol_version.description: Exact match. A different version is rejected outright — never downgraded, never best-effort parsed.

identity.description: Must resolve in the Capability Discovery directory. Unknown senders are refused.

identity_is_isolated.description: False when authentication_method is hmac_shared_secret: the identity is CLAIMED, not cryptographically isolated, because every mirror holds the same secret.

nonce.description: Single use. A repeat is a replay and is refused.

disposition.description: Structural. An inbound envelope cannot declare itself an instruction, a command, or an authorization.

confers_authority.description: Present and false so the answer is explicit rather than inferred from absence.
